slots.notes: Navbar brand wordmark logo, displayed 140x33px next to a vertical divider and 'STYLE GUIDE' label
Light-theme card cover photos, rendered 120px tall with object-fit cover (source ~400x200); one per content card
Flag icons inside dark-theme language pills, 24x18px object-fit contain; one per language pill (Spanish/French/German/Japanese)
Overlapping circular avatars in the dark-theme avatar group, 36px diameter with 50% radius and 2px white border; followed by a '+5' count badge

mechanic: A static single-page style-guide showcase — fixed navbar over a gradient hero and an eight-panel two-column grid — whose signature motion is the skeuomorphic 3D button press (a colored box-shadow that collapses as the button translateY(4px) on active) plus hover lifts on swatches and cards.
techDelivery: single-file inline CSS + HTML using CSS custom properties for the palette, Google Fonts (Nunito) and an onlinewebfonts CDN @font-face (Feather Bold), no JS framework or scroll library
reskinNotes: Many tints are hardcoded as per-element rgba/hex literals rather than referencing the CSS variables (e.g. button shadows #CFCFCF/#CC3C3C/#88879F, dark-theme badge text #7ADB2E/#4DC4F8/#b8920f, '10%/12%/15% opacity' tag backgrounds), so a palette swap requires editing inline values throughout, not just the :root variables. The display font is fetched from a fragile third-party onlinewebfonts URL. Layout is font-metric-dependent (lowercase Feather Bold headline at fixed 52px) and all copy is hardcoded in markup.
